title: A traffic management system for large and heterogeneous vehicles in narrow industrial environments
journal_ref: The International Journal of Robotics Research. 2026
summary: The coordination of Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) in high-density industrial environments represents a critical challenge within Logistics 4.0, as traditional traffic management methods often lead to inefficiencies caused by negotiation-based priority assignment. To overcome the resulting limitations, this paper presents an innovative AGV traffic management system based on a Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (L-MAPF) algorithm operating on roadmaps generated with Non-Uniform Rational B-Splines (NURBS) curves. The approach guarantees locally optimal coordination and ensures safe operation of large and heterogeneous AGVs. Building on this concept, the proposed framework integrates a modified version of the Bounded Horizon Conflict Based Search (CBS) technique within a Rolling Horizon Conflict Resolution strategy, utilizing an extended time horizon for each agent to enable effective conflict resolution in corridors identified by a topological map. In contrast to state-of-the-art methods for AGV fleet traffic management, the proposed solution is designed for real-world, non-standardized (i.e., non-grid-like) industrial settings characterized by narrow bidirectional corridors and high-traffic density, where AGVs of various sizes and capabilities operate simultaneously. Key contributions include an anytime conflict resolution strategy with adaptive time horizon regulation, an execution layer for safe and standard-compliant interaction with real AGVs, and an advanced mechanism for deadlock detection and resolution. Experimental results obtained in realistic industrial environments demonstrate higher throughput, with improvements of up to 11% over a conventional rule-based traffic management system, a state-of-the-art industrial method, and a priority-based L-MAPF variant, while maintaining continuous operation and improved efficiency.

AI.problem: 具体任务：面向物流4.0高密度工业环境中自动导引车（AGV）车队的交通管理/协调问题。现有瓶颈：传统交通管理方法依赖基于协商的优先级分配，导致在窄双向走廊、高交通密度、AGV尺寸与能力异构的实际非标准化（非网格状）工业环境中效率低下。关键问题：如何在上述真实工业场景中实现大型异构AGV的安全、局部最优且高吞吐量的协同控制，同时具备死锁检测与解决能力。
AI.method: 提出一种基于终身多智能体路径规划（Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding, L-MAPF）算法的AGV交通管理系统，路径图由非均匀有理B样条（NURBS）曲线生成，保证局部最优协调与大/异构AGV的安全运行。系统集成了改进的Bounded Horizon Conflict Based Search（CBS）技术，内置滚动时域冲突解决（Rolling Horizon Conflict Resolution）策略，利用拓扑图识别的走廊为每个智能体扩展时间视界以有效解决冲突。核心设计包括：①随时（anytime）冲突解决策略，带自适应时间视界调节；②执行层（execution layer），实现与真实AGV安全且符合标准的交互；③先进的死锁检测与解决机制。
AI.experiment: 在真实工业环境中开展的实验结果：相比常规基于规则的交通管理系统、一种工业级先进方法以及一种基于优先级的L-MAPF变体，所提出系统实现了更高的吞吐量，吞吐量提升最高达11%，同时保持持续运行并改善效率。摘要中未给出更详细的实验设置、指标和结果。
